# ctyun_cloud_assistant_invocation_results (Data Source)
-> 查询云助手命令执行结果



## Example

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ctyun = {
      source = "ctyun-it/ctyun"
    }
  }
}

# 可参考index.md，在环境变量中配置ak、sk、资源池ID、可用区名称
provider "ctyun" {
  env = "prod"
}



# 查询云助手命令执行结果
data "ctyun_cloud_assistant_invocation_results" "test" {
  page_no    = 1
  page_size  = 10
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `command_id` (String) 命令 ID
- `invoked_id` (String) 命令执行 ID
- `page_no` (Number) 当前页码，默认为 1
- `page_size` (Number) 每页行数，最大100，默认为 10
- `region_id` (String) 资源池 ID

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) 命令执行结果列表 (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))
- `total_count` (Number) 命令总个数

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `command_id` (String) 命令 ID
- `create_time` (String) 命令执行创建时间
- `error_info` (String) 命令执行失败原因
- `exit_code` (Number) 命令退出码
- `instance_id` (String) 云主机 ID
- `invocation_status` (String) 命令运行状态：Pending/Running/Success/Failed
- `invoked_id` (String) 命令执行 ID
- `output` (String) 命令执行输出信息
- `update_time` (String) 命令执行完成时间
